title: Roundabout Entry: Yield Before Joining
handbookSource: California Driver’s Handbook · Section 7 · Roundabouts. https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/handbook/california-driver-handbook/laws-and-rules-of-the-road/ (checked 2026-10-15; final human review pending)
learnerPrompt: The blue car is coming around. When do you enter?

choices.label: Enter ahead of the blue car

safeOutcome: Traffic already in the circle goes first. You enter behind blue with room between the cars.
unsafeOutcome: Blue already had the lane. Entering ahead cut across its path. Wait for a gap behind it.
